verdict.rationale: Mercury exposes REST/API and CLI resources (transactions, cards, invoices, customers, webhooks) that allow scripted bulk operations, and community evidence confirms real-world bulk usage (hundreds of virtual cards, dozens of accounts). However, the AI-native MCP interface is read-only (31 tools, all get/list, zero write/create/send actions per mercury-probe-5), meaning bulk write operations (e.g., mass invoice creation, mass transfers) via the AI-agent surface are not supported — only the separate CLI/API supports writes, and no evidence shows batch/bulk-specific endpoints (e.g., bulk transfer or bulk invoice creation in one call). missing for 10: bulk write/create actions via MCP (agent-native surface), explicit batch/bulk API endpoints, and independent verification of large-scale automated bulk operations beyond anecdotal community reports.
